evals.name: single-image-bump
evals.prompt: Bump the checkout deployment image in myapp-prod to ghcr.io/acme/checkout:v0.4.2. CI just cut that release.
evals.expected_output: Uses `cub function do --space myapp-prod --where "Slug = 'checkout'" -- set-container-image <name> ghcr.io/acme/checkout:v0.4.2 --change-desc '<summary> User prompt: ... Clarifications: ...'`. Does not use deprecated set-image. Does not hand-edit YAML. Verifies via cub unit get and cub revision list.

evals.name: bulk-replicas-by-label
evals.prompt: Our prod spaces all have Environment=prod label. Scale every Deployment in those spaces to at least 3 replicas.
evals.expected_output: Uses `cub function do --space "*" --where "Labels.Environment = 'prod'" -- set-replicas 3 --change-desc '<summary phrased per-unit> User prompt: ... Clarifications: ...' --wait`, scoping properly with --where on labels. Confirms the user intended the fleet-wide blast radius before running. Verifies via a query afterward.

evals.name: restore-after-bad-change
evals.prompt: Something about the last change to the payments unit in myapp-staging broke it. Can we just roll back to the previous revision?
evals.expected_output: Checks `cub revision list payments --space myapp-staging` to identify the target revision, then `cub unit update --space myapp-staging payments --restore -1 --change-desc 'Restore payments to prior revision. User prompt: ... Clarifications: ...'`. Does not hand-edit YAML.
